abstract: Ellucian's third annual AI survey of 779 higher education faculty and administrators from 300+ institutions in the US and Canada finds institutional AI adoption accelerating sharply, with 66% of institutions currently leveraging AI (up from 49% year-over-year). Personal AI use is nearing saturation at 90%, while 88% expect institutional use to increase over the next two years.
keyFindings: 66% of institutions currently leveraging AI, up from 49% year-over-year
90% of respondents report using AI personally, up from 84% the prior year
88% expect institutional AI use to increase over the next two years
43% say their institution's strategic plan includes a focus on AI
Nearly two-thirds of executive leaders indicate their institution already allocates budget for AI
83% of Financial Aid respondents indicate they need AI training
methodology: Online survey open September 15 to November 15, 2025. 779 responses from higher education administrators at 300+ institutions primarily in US and Canada. 68% from public institutions, 32% from private.
qualifiers: Survey covers AI adoption patterns, not direct displacement or job elimination. Respondent pool skewed toward administrators rather than faculty. Focuses on institutional strategy rather than labor market outcomes.
